maintenance_led.reason: Sells new steel, plastic and fibre drums, IBCs and containerboard as consumable packaging; reconditioning is a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial firms in chemicals, paints, lubricants, food and similar sectors buying packaging.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own packaging manufacturing and sales, with only occasional acquisitions or divestitures.

mission_critical.reason: Industrial drums, IBCs and paperboard are largely standard packaging that customers can source from competitors fairly easily.

notes: Some UN-certified or barrier packaging may raise switching costs, but most products look substitutable.
